npcs.name: Assay-Warden Ainethach
npcs.greet: Hired mercenaries stand at the Karthwasten adit with Silver-Blood eviction writs while redoubt fires burn along every crag.

npcs.name: Keeper Raerek
npcs.greet: Understone Keep issues warrants that never reach the Jarl's table—the Treasury House and Cidhna's wardens write their own law.

npcs.name: Hostler Eydis
npcs.greet: Caravans on the southern road pay silver to both the syndicate guards and the briar-shamans holding Serpent's Bluff.

the_reach_understone_settlement: Keeper Raerek: The Druadach prison-ledgers and the Treasury House warrant-seals expose both ends of the Cidhna arrangement.
Assay-Warden Ainethach: With the independent mines recognized under Understone charter, the crag-roads can finally hold a truce.
Keeper Raerek: Carve the verdict into the stone gallery—Markarth's courts answer to the hold, not the counting-house.

stages.objective: Hear the assay-warden's plea at Karthwasten regarding the seized silver veins.
Recover the forged deed-rolls from the mercenary bailiffs at Kolskeggr Mine.
Present the forged deed-rolls to the steward in Understone Keep at Markarth.
Inspect the prisoner transfer ledgers outside Cidhna's iron gates in Markarth.
Question the courier guards at Left Hand Mine and recover the sealed dispatch pouch.
Retrieve the secret correspondence between the Treasury factors and the chieftains in Druadach Redoubt.
Meet the southern caravan hostler at Old Hroldan.
Clear the cliff-pass ambushers stationed at Serpent's Bluff Redoubt.
Recover the stolen smelting-press valves from the outer halls of Bthardamz.
Light the ancient signal-terrace overlooking the Karth gorge at Sky Haven Temple.
Defeat the coven matriarch at Hag Rock Redoubt and reclaim the boundary-torcs.
Enforce the Karth Mining & Redoubt Settlement in Understone Keep at Markarth.
